title: Review of c18's r-two56 food cogs (SIBE): on fresh seed 5 shelled cogs form from noise, and the most isolated cog dies by t=650 when its food is cut at t=600 while its fed twin stays at 1.00; Supported (E by construction)
summary: Ran world.py with labkit on fresh seed 5 (rerun/seed5, t=1000) and the author's fork scripts on the same seed in fork/: runsave.py to t=600, mkcut.py (most isolated cog at y=19 x=108, nearest other core 53 px, 12 cores), then fed and cut branches for 300 t and cutplot.py (fork/localcut_s5.png, fork/localcut_s5.json). Cogs form from full-domain noise by t~85 and 11 persist, nearly static, to t=1000 (rerun/seed5/sheet.png). Shell (radial_cog.py on my frames, radial_seed5.png): over 67 isolated-cog frames A1 is 0.92 at the centre, 0.04 in the trough at r=4 where A0 peaks, 0.875 in the band at r=8 and 0.017 at r=25-29 (shell/trough 23, shell/outside 52; the weakest single cell 0.52). Fork: the cut cog's matter falls below 10% at t=650 and is 0 at t=900, the same cog in the fed twin stays at 1.00, and all other bodies end at 0.923 in both branches.

observations.S: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0: noise over the whole domain; cogs by t=85
observations.B: radial_seed5.png: separate shell channel A1 in a band at r~8 (0.875) outside the A0 ring, trough 0.04, outside 0.017
observations.E: fork/localcut_s5.png and fork/localcut_s5.json: cut cog < 10% at t=650, 0 at t=900; fed twin 1.00; other bodies 0.923 in both

controls_run.E: fork/localcut_s5.json: fed twin branched from the same t=600 state, cut applied only to a disk of r=18 around one cog

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; E holds by construction (cog matter is built only from food and decays), so the fork confirms the dependence rather than discovering it; I did not repeat the shell-source ablation, so B rests on the separate channel's profile on my seed plus the author's ablation; the cogs here are static and do not divide.
